title: Assessing the value of explainable artificial intelligence for magnetic resonance imaging
core_idea: Apply multiple XAI methods to an MRI-based diagnostic support model for distal myopathies to generate detailed, interpretable explanations for model predictions. Introduce a hierarchical occlusion technique and an ensemble framework that combines individual explanations into refined visualizations, and use expert radiologist feedback to assess their effectiveness while considering ethical and regulatory transparency requirements (e.g., GDPR, AI Act).
tldr: Use hierarchical occlusion and an ensemble of explainability methods to produce clinician-oriented, interpretable visualizations for an MRI diagnostic support model of distal myopathies and evaluate them with radiologist feedback to improve trust and regulatory-compliant transparency.
